name: macos-watchdog
description: >- Design, deploy, and discipline macOS launchd watchdogs — LaunchAgents/LaunchDaemons that detect a recurring problem and auto-remediate it. author: daymade
summary_zh: 用于设计、部署和约束 macOS 的 launchd 守护监控，在后台问题反复出现时自动修复，并避免监控自身反复拉起应用、刷通知或无休止重试。
